verdict.rationale: Docs confirm configurable sync frequency down to 1-minute syncs (fivetran-docs-11) and scheduled/triggered transformations (fivetran-docs-37), plus REST API for programmatic pipeline management (fivetran-docs-3, fivetran-docs-22). However there is no explicit documentation of cron-expression scheduling or manual on-demand sync triggers per connector. missing for 10: cron expression scheduling support, manual trigger/on-demand sync documentation, independent confirmation of granular per-pipeline frequency control.
